dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. For every included clinic/listing, procedures[] contains every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the reviewed public pages, not only Botox, fillers, rhinoplasty, breast augmentation, hair transplant or peels.

trust_policy.official_public_price_page: Direct public clinic/practice pricing page; preferred source.
trust_policy.official_context_price: Clinic's own public planning/average price rather than a personalized quote.
trust_policy.official_network_price: Public network-wide price applied to a real local branch; not branch-specific.
trust_policy.public_pricing_directory: Third-party public pricing directory; lower trust than official clinic pricing.
trust_policy.historical_public_pricing_directory: Historical third-party price; should not be used as a current default without revalidation.
trust_policy.patient_reported: Public patient-reported price; lower trust and not a default current price.

limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; booking-only, private-quote, login-only, unindexed or phone-only prices may be absent.
Rows without a numeric public price are omitted rather than estimated.
Starting, range, package, member, per-unit, per-syringe and per-graft semantics are preserved.
Tampa Bay coverage includes Clearwater, St. Petersburg, Seminole and nearby Tampa-metro locations where relevant.
Some hair-transplant, breast-augmentation and rhinoplasty rows come from public directories; source_type marks them separately so the app can rank official prices first.
Historical rhinoplasty entries are included only to broaden comparison coverage and are explicitly marked historical; they should not be the app's current default price.
